title: Cartwise Rewards Tier Retention Rates for Cartwise+ Membership Carried-Value Refunds
content:
When the value an earlier fee charge carried into a Cartwise+ Membership annual term is refunded on the term's early end, the carried retention rate follows the member's Cartwise Rewards tier.

| Member's Cartwise Rewards tier | Carried retention rate |
|---|---|
| Cartwise Rewards Gold, Platinum or Diamond | 1.0 (100%) |
| Cartwise Rewards Silver or Bronze | 0.95 (95%) |
| any other tier, or no Cartwise Rewards account | no rate set under this table |

## Reading the table

- The tier is read from the member's Cartwise Rewards account as it stands today.
- The rate multiplies the part of the carried value being refunded, and the product is rounded to the cent.

## Hypothetical illustrations

| Tier | Part of the carried value being refunded | Amount at the tier's rate |
|---|---|---|
| Cartwise Rewards Diamond | 6.20 | 6.20 multiplied by 1.0 is 6.20 |
| Cartwise Rewards Silver | 6.20 | 6.20 multiplied by 0.95 is 5.89 |
| Cartwise Rewards Member | 6.20 | no rate set under this table |
